note: Pre-registered before any AI news signal was audited. Do not edit to fit results; bump version instead. Until `promotion` passes, AI-read news is display only and nothing feeds the model. Checked by news_audit.promotion_check on every full run (history/news_audit.json).

population.description: AI signals that would be allowed to act as QB-availability overrides, and the ones precision is measured on
population.unit: one per (game, player, signal), timed at first seen; in the population if any copy of it met these conditions

promotion.ground_truth: actual starting QB (nflverse schedule home_qb_id/away_qb_id): positive signals correct if he started, negative signals if he did not

override_when_promoted.description: How an eligible signal would act once promoted, like an overrides.json entry {game_id: {side_qb_play_prob}}; overrides.json (manual) keeps precedence. NOT wired into predictions while eligible is false.
override_when_promoted.applies_to: the game assigned by team_verified (the team's next game within 10 days)
override_when_promoted.starter_named: will_start / expected_to_play / returning for a QB other than the listed starter: listed starter's play prob 0.0 and the named QB is the replacement
